name: Kova Slip-Form Loafer
description: A structured penny loafer with a chunky lug sole that keeps it from reading as purely formal. Upper is a soft brushed synth-suede in cognac or slate. The lug sole is the tell — this is a shoe that goes from boardroom to dinner without changing. Very popular in Tier 3-4 circles where the lines between work and social are permanently blurred.
what_it_says: You're adaptable. You move between contexts without effort and your shoes prove it.
story_hooks: Kova's cognac colorway was worn by a famous whistleblower in a widely-circulated arrest photo — the shoe now carries an ironic underground cachet.
A street vendor near the Tier 2-3 border sells convincing fakes that fall apart in two months.
